text.autoconfig.bettermaceswap.title: Better Mace Swap Config
text.autoconfig.bettermaceswap.option.au: Automatically swap to Mace when hitting with a Sword or Axe.
text.autoconfig.bettermaceswap.option.sm: Automatically picks Density when falling and Breach when on the ground.
text.autoconfig.bettermaceswap.option.br: Ticks to wait before swapping back to your previous item.
Whether Attribute Swap fires on all items or weapons only.
text.autoconfig.bettermaceswap.option.co: Enable auto-swaps and stun logic against players.
Enable auto-swaps and stun logic against mobs and animals.
text.autoconfig.bettermaceswap.option.ma: Prioritized enchantment when Smart Switch is OFF.
text.autoconfig.bettermaceswap.option.at: Decide if swaps trigger on all items or just weapons.
text.autoconfig.bettermaceswap.option.au: Automatically Axe-stun then Mace-slam when hitting a shield.
text.autoconfig.bettermaceswap.option.st: Whether Stun Slam fires on weapons only or all items.
Return to your previous slot after the stun slam combo.
text.autoconfig.bettermaceswap.option.sa: Only trigger stun slam when it is safe to do so.
text.autoconfig.bettermaceswap.option.pe: Fire a Wind Charge after throwing an Ender Pearl while looking up.
Ticks to wait after pearl throw before firing Wind Charge.
Minimum pitch angle to trigger Pearl Catch.
Snap to a set pitch after the pearl catch fires.
Pitch value to snap to after the pearl catch. Negative = look up.
Which slot to return to after a pearl/wind combo.
text.autoconfig.bettermaceswap.option.ai: Smoothly tracks targets while falling for Mace slams.
How fast the crosshair moves toward the target.
Blocks you must fall before Aim Assist activates.
Aim assist tracks mobs and animals.
Which part of the body to aim at (Eye, Chest, or Legs).
WHILE FALLING: Only aims when falling. ALWAYS: Aims whenever a target is found.
text.autoconfig.bettermaceswap.option.tr: Automatically attack when looking at a valid target.
Only attack automatically if you are currently falling.
text.autoconfig.bettermaceswap.option.au: Equip chestplate automatically when combat features trigger.
text.autoconfig.bettermaceswap.option.lu: Automatically swap to Mace when using Wind Charge lunge.
Delay before swapping back after a lunge.
text.autoconfig.bettermaceswap.option.wi: Right-clicking with a weapon fires a Wind Charge from inventory.
text.autoconfig.bettermaceswap.option.ro: Automatically use a firework rocket to boost while flying with elytra.
text.autoconfig.bettermaceswap.option.au: Automatically jump before firing a Wind Charge for extra height.
text.autoconfig.bettermaceswap.option.ai: Automatically splash speed/strength potions while in the air.
text.autoconfig.bettermaceswap.option.ex: Use physics simulation to track and catch the pearl mid-air instead of snapping pitch.
